DS065 is a medical diagnosis code designating traumatic subdural hemorrhage. In the context of the Danish healthcare system, it serves as a critical data point for monitoring the safety of anticoagulation therapy among patients with [[atrieflimren|atrieflimren]]. The code is systematically tracked by national clinical quality databases, specifically the Atrial Fibrillation in Denmark (AFDK) registry managed by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) [^src1].

To evaluate the safety of treatments and adjust clinical guidelines, Danish health authorities rely on specific clinical quality indicators. DS065 is one of the core diagnosis codes used to calculate the incidence of [[intrakraniel-bloedning|Intrakraniel blødning]] (intracranial hemorrhage) in prevalent atrial fibrillation patients [^src1]. It is grouped with other intracranial bleeding codes, including [[di60|DI60]], [[di61|DI61]], [[di62|DI62]], [[ds064|DS064]], and [[ds066|DS066]], to ensure comprehensive surveillance of neurological bleeding complications [^src1]. 

Beyond isolated intracranial events, DS065 is also incorporated into a broader composite indicator that measures the incidence of severe bleeding overall [^src1]. This wider metric aggregates intracranial hemorrhages with gastrointestinal, urinary tract, and pulmonary bleeding codes to provide a holistic view of anticoagulation-related risks [^src1]. Through the continuous extraction of DS065 and related codes from the Danish National Patient Register, clinicians and policymakers can assess demographic challenges, evaluate risk profiles, and refine national treatment strategies [^src1].

## Claims

**Diagnostic**
- For incidens af intrakraniel blødning anvendes diagnoserne DI60, DI61, DI62, DS064, DS065 og DS066 [^src1]
- For incidens af alvorlig blødning anvendes en bred vifte af diagnoser, herunder DI60–DS066 for intrakraniel blødning, DK25.0–DK29.8A og DK92.0–DK92.2 for gastrointestinal blødning samt DJ942, DN02, DR04 og DR31 for urinvejs-/lunge blødning [^src1]
